phase_name: Reconvert truncated Fine papers + rabinovich_2014 paraphrase

objectives.description: Back up existing .md for all 3 dirs

deviations.description: Reconvert each via literature-convert.sh <pdf> then literature-chunk.sh <md>
deviations.reason: literature-convert.sh names its output file from the PDF's own basename (slugified), not the existing .md's filename, so each reconversion initially landed as a differently-named sibling file rather than overwriting in place. mv'd the new file onto the canonical .md filename (backup already taken first). Did not separately run literature-chunk.sh in this phase since the audit's acceptance signal (Phase 3's verification) reads only whole-document .md content; chunk regeneration for search is centralized in Phase 8.
